nodes.text: Let Origen be confounded, among the other kinds of outrage that he invents, for granting his patronage to the magic arts as well. For in his treatises he spoke in these words: ‘The magic art does not seem to me to be the name of any really existing thing; but even if it is, it is not a work of evil, nor something that could be held in contempt.’
